SPEC COMPLIANCE CHUNK SOF-VD-06: SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition — ViewDefinition.select.forEach, ViewDefinition.select.forEachOrNull. Test these items: forEach 0..1 FHIRPath expression selects parent elements for the containing select, forEach multiplies rows for each item in the selected collection, forEach suppresses rows when the collection is empty, forEachOrNull preserves one row with null nested values when the collection is empty, nested columns are evaluated relative to each iterated item, built-in ViewDefinition/FHIRPath variables remain correct in iterated contexts, including %context, %resource, %rootResource, and %rowIndex. For DuckDB-backed FHIRPath/CQL surfaces, test both the native/C++ extension path and the Python fallback where both exist, and compare outputs between paths. For SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition chunks, test parser validation, SQL generation, DuckDB execution, and official spec fixtures/examples relevant to the chunk.

When the pipeline is fully complete, set workflow to null, set exit_reason, write all handoff files, and return control to the outer spec compliance orchestrator.

issues.spec_citation: SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition sql-expressions constraint: ViewDefinition.select can only have at most one of forEach, forEachOrNull, or repeat.
issues.evidence: Fresh probe showed parse_view_definition() and validate_view_definition() accepted Selects with forEach+repeat and forEachOrNull+repeat; SQL generation rejected later. Parser/public validator boundary should enforce the logical model constraint.
issues.root_cause: Parser/public validator checked forEach plus forEachOrNull but did not include repeat in the SQL-on-FHIR sql-expressions mutual-exclusion constraint.
issues.resolution: Added parser and validate_view_definition checks requiring at most one of forEach, forEachOrNull, or repeat; added parser/direct dataclass regression tests.
issues.verified_in: Focused parser pytest 5 passed; ViewDefinition pytest 838 passed; ViewDefinition conformance 134/134; full conformance 2822/2822; full pytest 7376 passed.

issues.spec_citation: SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition forEach applies to columns and nested selects; FHIRPath environment variables are values supplied by the calling environment, including %context. SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition also uses %resource/%rootResource in iterated contexts.
issues.evidence: Fresh native and forced-Python probes under forEach(contact) returned ContactFam for %resource.name.family.first() instead of the root Patient name RootFam because generator only rerouted simple navigation tails and evaluated complex %resource.* against the iterator alias.
issues.root_cause: SQLGenerator only rerouted simple dot-navigation tails for leading built-in variables, so function/predicate tails such as %resource.name.family.first() were sent to the current iterator alias.
issues.resolution: Routed full leading %context/%resource/%rootResource FHIRPath tails to the correct current/root JSON input when no other root/current built-in is referenced; mixed root/current built-ins now fail fast with ValidationError.
issues.verified_in: Focused native-loaded and forced Python fallback DuckDB pytest 2 passed; ViewDefinition pytest 838 passed; ViewDefinition conformance 134/134; full conformance 2822/2822; full pytest 7376 passed.
